content.short: Hyperbeat is a self-custodial onchain account on Hyperliquid to save, spend, trade and ramp.
content.description: Hyperbeat presents Hyperliquid as a single self-custodial account covering saving, spending, trading and fiat on-ramping, with yield vaults underneath. Wrapping several primitives behind one account is how consumer products usually make a chain approachable, though it puts considerable weight on the interface getting the underlying risks across.
